name: Athens
tagline: Ancient Civilization Meets Modern FIRE Living
description: Athens combines 3,000 years of history with surprisingly affordable Mediterranean living. The Greek Golden Visa program, generous non-dom tax options, and low cost of living make it an increasingly popular FIRE destination. Add island-hopping from Piraeus, year-round sunshine, and some of Europe's best street food, and Athens punches well above its weight.

quickFacts.visa: Golden Visa via real estate investment (€250K+ in select areas). Financially Independent Person visa also available. Non-dom flat tax option for foreign income.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Safe — standard urban awareness in Omonia area, otherwise very safe and welcoming
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Athens International Airport Eleftherios Venizelos (ATH) — 40 min from center by metro
quickFacts.climate: Hot Mediterranean with mild winters (8-14°C) and hot, dry summers (28-35°C). 250+ sunny days per year.

housing.description: Room in a shared flat / micro-studio, Kypseli / Patissia / Sepolia

dining.description: Mostly home cooking with souvlaki and a neighborhood kafeneio, the occasional taverna

healthcare.description: An entry-level Greek private plan covering basic hospital and emergency care - the minimum that satisfies Greece's financially-independent-person visa insurance requirement.

transportation.description: OASA 30-day urban pass across metro/bus/tram/suburban rail

entertainment.description: Free archaeological sites, rooftop Acropolis views and coastal beach days

1M.lifestyle: A room in a shared flat or a micro-studio in a residential district like Kypseli, Patissia, or Sepolia. Cooking at home is the default, with souvlaki, a neighborhood kafeneio, and the occasional taverna meal as the everyday outing. Movement runs on the inexpensive OASA monthly pass across metro, bus, tram, and suburban rail, and an FIP-compliant private health policy is carried. Much of what makes Athens special — the archaeological sites, rooftop Acropolis views, and beach trips to the coast — costs little or nothing. Summer heat pushes up air-conditioning bills, but the rhythm is frugal and genuinely livable.

dining.description: New-wave tavernas and mezze spots several times a week

healthcare.description: Comprehensive domestic private plan, mainstream Greek insurer network

transportation.description: OASA 30-day urban pass across metro/bus/tram/suburban rail

entertainment.description: Epidaurus theater, island-hopping weekends and Riviera beach clubs

2M.lifestyle: A studio or small one-bedroom in a lively area such as Petralona, Exarchia, or Ambelokipi. Dining out several times a week at Athens' new-wave tavernas and mezze spots, comprehensive private cover, and easy ferry weekends to Hydra or Aegina. High English fluency makes daily errands straightforward. Everyday life is comfortable and social without stretching the budget.

housing.description: 1BR in a desirable central district — Koukaki / Pangrati / Mets

dining.description: Regular meals at well-regarded restaurants plus seafood at Mikrolimano

healthcare.description: Broad-network domestic plan, wider hospital access, faster private specialists

transportation.description: Pass + occasional taxi via FREENOW or Uber Taxi

entertainment.description: Saronic boat trips, VIP Epidaurus tickets and beach-club access

3M.lifestyle: A one-bedroom in a desirable central district — Koukaki, Pangrati, or Mets — within walking distance of the Acropolis and the best street food. Regular dining at well-regarded restaurants, a broad-network private plan with fast specialist access, and the transit pass with taxi apps on top plus weekend rental cars for coastal drives and the Peloponnese. Boat day trips to the Saronic islands and Epidaurus theater tickets fit easily. This is a genuinely affluent Athens life with room to spare.

dining.description: Near-daily dining at the city's top tables

healthcare.description: Premium / entry-international plan, regional cover, low deductible

entertainment.description: Seasonal island excursions, exclusive social memberships and frequent travel

5M.lifestyle: A high-spec one-bedroom in prime-central Kolonaki. Near-daily dining at the city's top tables, premium private health cover, regular housekeeping, and a leased luxury car on top of the metro. The Athenian Riviera's beach clubs, seasonal island excursions, and frequent European travel round out the calendar. Athens' moderate costs mean this tier delivers upper-affluent living with a comfortable margin.

housing.description: Luxury 1–2BR at a prime address, Kolonaki / Athens Riviera (Glyfada–Vouliagmeni)

dining.description: Private-chef-level dining and Athens' finest restaurants

healthcare.description: Top-tier international/worldwide cover (Cigna Global / Bupa Global)

transportation.description: Premium car + private transfers + transit + seasonal fast-ferry

entertainment.description: Aegean yacht charters, cultural patronage and elite social life

10M.lifestyle: A luxury one-to-two-bedroom in Kolonaki or a prime address on the Athens Riviera between Glyfada and Vouliagmeni, with easy coastal access. Private-chef-level dining, top-tier international health cover, a premium car and private transfers alongside transit — with a driver for occasions — and full household help. Occasional Aegean boat charters mark the summer and travel is first-class by default. Athens at this level is very comfortable, though its ultra-luxury infrastructure is thinner than in London or Paris, so much of the discretionary budget flows into travel.
